patch.summary:
Choose Azure DevOps only if your buying job matches “Azure Repos/Boards/Pipelines — first 5 Basic users free, then $6/user/mo; Basic + Test Pla” rather than ThorData's shape. Choose ThorData only if your buying job matches “Budget proxy + scraper tooling — Residential from $2/GB (1GB pack); Web Scraper API credit” rather than Azure DevOps's shape. Workflow advantage: Azure DevOps leans source-control-devops; ThorData leans web-data-collection. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Positioning: Azure DevOps is Azure Repos/Boards/Pipelines — first 5 Basic users free, then $6/user/mo; Basic + Test Plans $52/user/mo; Artifacts 2 GiB free.; ThorData is Budget proxy + scraper tooling — Residential from $2/GB (1GB pack); Web Scraper API credit packs from ~$30..
- Company-size focus: Azure DevOps (small-business, mid-market, enterprise) vs ThorData (solo, micro, small-business).
- Workflow coverage skew: Azure DevOps-leaning source-control-devops vs ThorData-leaning web-data-collection.
- Researched limits: Azure DevOps — User 6 onwards is $6/user/mo for every additional Basic seat — the free five are not a forever team cap workaround; ThorData — Brand maturity and enterprise compliance story are thinner than Bright Data / Oxylabs.

Limitations — Azure DevOps: User 6 onwards is $6/user/mo for every additional Basic seat — the free five are not a forever team cap workaround; Test Plans at $52/user is a QA licence, not something to assign to every developer; ThorData: Brand maturity and enterprise compliance story are thinner than Bright Data / Oxylabs; Marketing claims should be validated — score from published packaging, not Fortune-500 slogans.

Poor-fit cases: Azure DevOps is a poor fit when that limitation bites: User 6 onwards is $6/user/mo for every additional Basic seat — the free five are not a forever team cap workaround · ThorData is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Brand maturity and enterprise compliance story are thinner than Bright Data / Oxylabs · Avoid Azure DevOps if you actually need ThorData's motion (Budget proxy + scraper tooling — Residential from $2/GB (1GB pack); Web Scraper )
